lines.en: I call Chinami and am immediately yelled at for disturbing her in the middle of what she calls a “very important business meeting.”
lines.zh: 我打电话给 Chinami，立刻被她吼了一顿，说我打扰了她所谓的「非常重要的商务会议」。

lines.en: I find out soon after that her “meeting” was just a Facetime conversation with Touka’s extremely bratty little sister about a whole bunch of animals they plan on distributing in the coming quarter.
lines.zh: 不久我就发现，她的「会议」不过是跟 Touka 那个极其刁蛮的妹妹开 FaceTime，聊一大堆她们打算在下个季度分发掉的动物。

lines.en: And while I think it’s nice that Chinami suddenly has a friend, I do wish she had one that was a little better of an influence.
lines.zh: 虽然 Chinami 突然有了朋友我觉得挺好，但我确实希望那个朋友能给点更好的影响。

lines.en: Which probably means nothing from me seeing as I am an adult male who is now en route to her house in the middle of the day, but still.
lines.zh: 当然这话从我说出来大概没什么分量——我可是个大男人，大中午正往她家赶，不过还是。

lines.en: When I arrive, Chinami is busy playing games on her phone and will only speak to me in between rounds of pig-slaughter.
lines.zh: 我到的时候，Chinami 正忙着在手机上打游戏，只在两局「屠猪」的间隙才跟我说话。

lines.en: I spend the rest of the time questioning my life and the decisions that may have led me here.
lines.zh: 剩下的时间我都在质疑自己的人生，以及可能把我带到这一步的那些决定。

lines.en: Chinami stops playing games after her phone suddenly dies and, as I help her look around for her charger, I’m glad that she’s getting so much use out of it.
lines.zh: 手机突然没电后 Chinami 就不玩了；我帮她找充电器时，挺高兴这手机派上了这么大用场。

lines.en: I can only imagine how boring it is having to spend day after day in one room.
lines.zh: 日复一日困在一个房间里有多无聊，我只能想象。

lines.en: Maybe that’s why I’m coming here?
lines.zh: 也许这就是我来这儿的原因？

lines.en: Maybe it’s something as simple as me feeling bad for her because she’s unable to go out and live a normal life.
lines.zh: 也许只是因为我同情她没法出去过正常生活，就这么简单。

lines.en: I decide that’s exactly what it is.
The only alternative would be much worse.
lines.zh: 唯一的另一种可能要糟糕得多。
Chinami 的好感度提升到了 [chinami_love]！
